turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Georgia Power customer service following up on your tree trimming request near the power lines.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, the oak branches in the backyard were getting very close to the transformer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our certified arborist crew has scheduled maintenance for next Tuesday between 8 AM and 12 PM.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Do I need to be home when they trim the branches?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, as long as our crew has access to the backyard utility easement, you do not need to be present.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: The side gate will be unlocked for them. Thank you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Warning: Geek Squad renewal department following up on an automatic invoice of $499.00.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I cancelled Geek Squad two years ago, why was I charged $499?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: An automated renewal occurred; to reverse the charge to your bank account, connect your PC to our cancellation server.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can't you just mail me a check for the refund?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our direct electronic refund protocol requires instant terminal verification within ten minutes or the charge becomes non-refundable.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Alright, I've opened the connection program you mentioned.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Emergency Notice: This is the Regional Power and Gas Disconnection Department.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes? What is this concerning? I have electricity right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A field technician is currently en route to your residence to physically disconnect your electricity meter due to an unpaid balance of $389.50.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Disconnect? But I have my oxygen machine running at home! I can't lose power!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The technician arrives in thirty minutes. You have exactly thirty minutes to pay, or power will be terminated for a mandatory 48-hour penalty period.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have my credit card right here, can I pay you over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our card processing system is currently offline for audit; you must purchase a MoneyPak reload card at Walgreens and read the barcode numbers over this live line.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I'm rushing to the store right away, please tell the technician to wait!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is Wells Fargo automated service follow-up regarding your recent debit card replacement request.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, I requested a new chip card last Tuesday because the magnetic strip was worn out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your new card was mailed via standard postal delivery and should arrive within three to five business days.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Great, how do I activate it once it arrives in the mail?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can activate it anytime by logging into your official online banking app or by calling the toll-free number printed on the sticker of the new card.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That's very convenient, thank you for checking in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer Raymond Vance from the Internal Revenue Service Criminal Investigation Division.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello? What is this about? I've never received any letter from the IRS.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Two formal notices were sent to your physical address but returned unclaimed; a federal tax lien has been placed on your name.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: A lien? There must be some mistake, I always pay my taxes through my CPA.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: An audit found an overdue discrepancy of $4,820. If not settled within the next forty-five minutes, local sheriff deputies will arrive with an active bench warrant.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Please, I'm 74 years old and living on social security, I can't go to jail! How do I fix this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must go immediately to the nearest retail kiosk, purchase a federal bond voucher, and do not disclose this matter to bank personnel as it violates federal non-disclosure regulations.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Okay, I'm writing down the directions right now, please stay on the phone with me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Bank of America Fraud Management calling to stop a pending $4,500 wire to an offshore crypto exchange.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: A wire transfer? I never approved any crypto exchange!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The transfer is queued in the gateway; you have three minutes to cancel it before the funds clear permanently.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Cancel it! How do I cancel it immediately?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will send a security bypass code to your smartphone; speak the six digits aloud to verify your authorization right now.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: The message says 'Never share this passcode with Bank of America associates'...

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am the senior system supervisor overriding the security block; if you do not read it now, the money will be gone forever.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Okay, the code is 9 1 4 2 8 8.
